caption: The image depicts a rectangular stone tablet with a raised border, shown in grayscale. At the top of the tablet, there is an inscription with uppercase German text that reads "HRISTEIN IEGER AUF DER IAGTALSO". Below the inscription, the majority of the surface is blank except for a horizontal rectangular panel at the bottom. Inside this lower panel, from left to right, there are two deer-like animals facing right with circular shapes above their backs; next, there is a standing human figure with an object held horizontally and a circular shape above its head; to the right of the figure, there is a five-pointed star-like shape; and finally, another deer-like animal on the far right facing left, also with a circular shape above its back. The tablet is light gray, and it is photographed with a border of off-white paper that has some small stains and marks around the edges.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
